from cfg import load_config

# Test int
cfg = load_config({'port': 80, 'host': 'x'}, {'APP_PORT': '8080'})
assert cfg['port'] == 8080, f'got {cfg[\"port\"]}'
assert cfg['host'] == 'x'

# Test float
cfg = load_config({'rate': 1.5}, {'APP_RATE': '2.5'})
assert cfg['rate'] == 2.5, f'got {cfg[\"rate\"]}'

# Test bool
cfg = load_config({'debug': False}, {'APP_DEBUG': 'true'})
assert cfg['debug'] == True, f'got {cfg[\"debug\"]}'

cfg = load_config({'debug': True}, {'APP_DEBUG': 'false'})
assert cfg['debug'] == False, f'got {cfg[\"debug\"]}'

# Test str
cfg = load_config({'name': 'default'}, {'APP_NAME': 'custom'})
assert cfg['name'] == 'custom', f'got {cfg[\"name\"]}'

# Test non-APP_ keys ignored
cfg = load_config({'x': 1}, {'OTHER': '2'})
assert cfg['x'] == 1

# Test unknown key ignored
cfg = load_config({'x': 1}, {'APP_Y': '2'})
assert cfg['x'] == 1

print('All manual tests passed')
